api: Asana API v1 pinned OpenAPI inventory
scope: Every HTTP operation in the pinned official Asana OpenAPI paths map is represented exactly once. Existing executable streams/writes stay covered_by. All remaining operations are blocked/planned fixed-target rows; destructive/admin/delete operations are in scope only through named reverse-ETL actions with typed destructive confirmation and plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute. The /batch raw subrequest wrapper is disallowed/not-applicable because every underlying operation is represented individually.
